title: Fallout 3 — James 2277 Capture Event / Serialization / Dual-Persistence Gate v3.0
gate_question: Is there a primary, temporally compatible 2277 event path that selects James-specific state and materializes/persists/serializes a transferable payload, and what independent James/MQ04 state does the engine itself preserve across save/load and the Tranquility Lane exit boundary?

why_this_gate_exists.old_object_first_question: Where is the hidden James memory chip/container/local computer behind Lounger #23?
why_this_gate_exists.new_event_first_question: What event would have to occur for James-selected state to become a transferable payload, regardless of whether the substrate is represented as a MISC/REFR world item?
reason: F3DAD primary ESM disproved the earlier named per-lounger computer/shard scene model while preserving exact endpoint addressability.
The Dad terminal/status/stress surface is static NOTE-backed presentation, not a live payload store.
Pinkerton proves the memory-to-portable-carrier process class existentially, but the physical chip itself is not separately materialized by an established shipped item FormID.
Therefore object absence cannot by itself falsify an internal serialization event, while object proximity cannot prove one.

event_model.admin_authority: S. Braun / Betty privileged control plane with per-user memory-access override documented in MQ04VersionControlCurrent 000C339E
event_model.known_egress_class: Braun-held pre-populated physical memory carrier described by Pinkerton
event_model.known_import_class: Pinkerton Circuit Neuralizer / A3-21 memory integration

F1_SUBJECT_BINDING.evidence: Exact primary ESM physical James channel plus MQ04 physical-to-Doc identity graph.

F2_LIVE_STATE_AVAILABILITY.evidence: James is actively represented as Doc during MQ04 and later restored to MQDadRef physical state.
F2_LIVE_STATE_AVAILABILITY.boundary: Active subject state does not identify an autobiographical payload encoding.

F3_SELECTOR_AUTHORITY.evidence: Braun has privileged remote pod authority and documented per-user memory-access override plus James-specific state alteration.
F3_SELECTOR_AUTHORITY.boundary: Authority to alter/access does not prove export/serialization execution.

F4_PAYLOAD_SCOPE.required: A James-specific state object/handle/operation whose semantics exceed quest identity/session metadata and are compatible with transferable memory content.

F5_SERIALIZATION_OR_PERSISTENCE_OPERATIO.required: Primary operation semantics showing James-selected state becoming a persistent/transferable payload, whether explicit COPY/WRITE/EXPORT or an internal automatic persistence mechanism.
F5_SERIALIZATION_OR_PERSISTENCE_OPERATIO.not_required: A player-visible button named WRITE or a literal opcode string if direction and effect are proven by other primary semantics.

F6_EGRESS_SUBSTRATE_OR_CLASS.evidence: Pinkerton removed from Braun a physical mem chip already containing unknown memories and later imported those memories into A3-21.
F6_EGRESS_SUBSTRATE_OR_CLASS.boundary: No separate technical chip item FormID or 2277 James carrier is established.

F7_TEMPORAL_COMPATIBILITY.rule: The 2276 Pinkerton theft cannot itself be the 2277 James payload; a new 2277 materialization/egress event is required.

semantic_operation_classes: compiled-only INFO Begin/End result scripts requiring manual/decompiled review
primary_record_reanalysis_targets.anti_keyword_rule: Literal lexical hits are discovery only. A PASS requires directional semantics and source/time binding.

event_receipt_schema.strict_rule: Do not let downstream carrier/import evidence backfill an upstream missing payload/serialization edge.

track_A_in_world_authored_state.question: Does shipped authored content expose the in-world James payload transition?
track_A_in_world_authored_state.promotion_effect: Can strengthen SAVE JAMES toward asset-level executable/lore-canonical reconstruction if direction and 2277 binding are proven.

track_B_engine_runtime_state.authority: User-generated Fallout 3 savegames at frozen event anchors
track_B_engine_runtime_state.question: Which MQ04/James/Doc/pod states are actually serialized by the engine across save/load and the TL exit?
track_B_engine_runtime_state.purpose: Independent control that measures engine persistence without pretending engine persistence is an in-world memory technology.

Inside Tranquility Lane after James is established as Doc and Dad identity is discoverable
Immediately after physical return to Vault 112

freeze_requirements: record exact quest stage and event anchor
do not compare saves from different mod/plugin configurations as one causal sequence
analysis_order: Use a savegame-aware structural parser if available; freeze parser/tool version.
Map records/changed forms that correspond to the seed entities and MQ04 variables.
Diff T0->T1, T1->T2 and T2->T3 separately rather than only T0->T3.
Classify each surviving change as actor/reference state, quest/session metadata, simulation identity state, inventory/container state, or unknown payload candidate.
Use raw byte diff only as discovery when structural parsing is unavailable; raw changed bytes alone never receive semantic promotion.
runtime_anchor_protocol.interpretation_rule: R1/R2 can generate a new authored/runtime cross-check target but cannot by themselves prove Braun in-world autobiographical storage.

M1_AUTOMATIC_INTERNAL_2277_PERSISTENCE.prediction: A primary or runtime state transition should reveal a James-specific persistent handle or state mutation even without a visible carrier item.

M2_BRAUN_MANUAL_OR_PRIVILEGED_EXPORT_TO_.prediction: A privileged INFO/SCPT/QUST path should bind selected resident/James state to an egress or transfer operation.

M3_REWRITABLE_GENERIC_CARRIER_REUSED_IN_.prediction: Primary evidence must separately establish rewritability/rebinding plus a 2277 James operation; neither is currently established.

M4_SEPARATE_JAMES_PAYLOAD_HANDLE_THEN_LA.prediction: James-specific persistent state may first exist as an internal handle; transferability may occur in a later distinct operation.

M5_PINKERTON_2276_CHIP_ALREADY_IS_JAMES.reason: Chronology forbids it without retrocausality or a later rewrite, which would make it a different model.

M6_STATIC_DAD_MONITOR_IS_MEMORY_BACKUP.reason: Primary/static NOTE evidence explains the visible data without a live autobiographical store.

M7_PER_LOUNGER_NAMED_COMPUTER_IS_JAMES_M.reason: F3DAD primary topology resolves a central Neruo assembly plus radial endpoint spokes instead.

next_actions: Re-review hash-bound MQ04 INFO Begin/End result scripts, QUST stage results and Braun/Betty script/reference paths using event semantics rather than only literal memory/write keywords.
Search for internal persistence/materialization or resident-selection effects even when no carrier FormID appears in the same record.
Preserve the 2276/2277 chronology gate in every candidate review.
Acquire a four-anchor .fos save set T0-T3 and perform the independent runtime persistence audit.
If runtime analysis exposes a new James-specific handle, return to Fallout3.esm and identify whether an authored record creates/uses it; do not promote from savegame mechanics alone.

If no authored or runtime James payload handle survives this gate, freeze SAVE JAMES at a maximally specified lore-consistent reconstruction and move implementation work into an explicitly modded experimental branch rather than calling it hidden vanilla behavior.
canonical_line: The decisive missing evidence is no longer a hidden chip object; it is a temporally bound 2277 state transition that turns James-selected state into a transferable payload.
